name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
source_notes: IDs and titles verified via OWASP's asi-2026.json mapping in the GenAI-LLM-Top10 repo and the genai.owasp.org resource page; descriptions and mitigations from secondary summaries.
caveats: Descriptions and mitigations are paraphrased from secondary summaries (Teleport, Giskard) of the PDF; the official PDF was not read, so they are unverified against OWASP text.
OWASP prose uses title variants (ASI02 "Tool Misuse", ASI05 "Unexpected Code Execution", ASI06 "Memory Poisoning"); secondary rewordings like "Cascading Agent Failures" are not official.
related LLM links are the OWASP Appendix A LLM-to-ASI crosswalk read in reverse; T-number links are inferred.
No project maturity level for this list was captured in the notes.
detection.static entries are reinhardt rule ideas, not OWASP text; ASI07 and ASI10 are mainly architectural/runtime.

items.name: Agent Goal Hijack
items.summary: Malicious content in untrusted inputs (documents, external data) manipulates an agent's objectives.
prevention: Apply least privilege to agent capabilities.
Require human approval for high-impact actions.

static: User input (req.body, searchParams) concatenated or templated into the system message instead of a separate user-role message
Fetched web/RAG/file content inserted into the prompt without delimiting or provenance labeling

items.name: Tool Misuse & Exploitation
items.summary: Legitimate tools are misused through poor scoping, over-privilege, ambiguous instructions, or tool confusion/typosquatting.

static: Tool definitions (tool({...}), tools: [...], LangChain DynamicTool, MCP server.tool(...)) whose execute calls exec/spawn/fs.writeFile/fs.rm or arbitrary fetch with model-chosen arguments and no allowlist
Tool input schemas that accept a free-form command or path (e.g. z.string() for a shell command or file path)
Destructive tools (delete/send/pay/transfer) with no confirmation or human-approval step

items.name: Identity & Privilege Abuse
items.summary: Agents abuse cached credentials, delegation chains or confused-deputy situations, leaving an attribution gap.
prevention: Issue unique, short-lived credentials per agent.

static: Admin/service-role DB credentials (e.g. Supabase service_role key) used inside AI tool routes
Authorization expressed only in prompt text (e.g. 'only admins may...') with no code check before the tool runs

items.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Malicious or compromised third-party models, plugins, tool descriptors or MCP servers are loaded at runtime.

static: MCP config (mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json) running packages via npx -y without a version pin or with @latest
MCP filesystem server rooted at / or ~, or tokens inlined in the MCP server env block

items.name: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Agent-generated or externally influenced code gets executed.
prevention: Run code in hardened non-root containers.

static: Model output (completion.choices[0].message.content, result.text, toolCall.args) flowing into eval, new Function, vm.runIn*, child_process.exec/execSync or spawn(..., {shell:true})

Tool definitions (tool({...}), tools: [...], LangChain DynamicTool, MCP server.tool(...)) whose execute calls exec/spawn/fs.writeFile/fs.rm or arbitrary fetch with model-chosen arguments and no allowlist
Tool input schemas that accept a free-form command or path (e.g. z.string() for a shell command or file path)

items.name: Memory & Context Poisoning
items.summary: Corrupted agent memory or RAG context biases future reasoning and actions.
prevention: Segment memory by user and task.

static: Model output persisted to long-term memory or a vector store without validation or per-user namespacing
Fetched web/RAG/file content inserted into the prompt without delimiting or provenance labeling

items.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
items.summary: Weak authentication or encryption between agents allows spoofing, tampering or interception.
prevention: Sign messages with nonces and timestamps.

review: Architectural/runtime concern; requires design review or runtime monitoring

items.name: Cascading Failures
items.summary: A single fault propagates and amplifies across networks of agents.
prevention: Apply rate limits and kill switches.

static: LLM calls with no max_tokens / maxOutputTokens / max_completion_tokens
Agent loops with no step cap (AI SDK stopWhen step-count condition, LangChain maxIterations)
AI API routes with no rate-limit middleware

items.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
items.summary: Users are manipulated into approving harmful actions proposed by an agent.
prevention: Show confidence and risk cues in the UI.

static: Destructive tools (delete/send/pay/transfer) with no confirmation or human-approval step

items.name: Rogue Agents
items.summary: Agents deviate from their intended purpose through compromise or misalignment.
prevention: Define trust boundaries and isolate agents.

review: Architectural/runtime concern; requires design review or runtime monitoring
